GATE TASK: TWO defects on one line of code; the issue itself says the referenced-by fix 'ships with #2 -- same line'. (a) D2: astx.py:_func emits mod:{clsstack[-1]}.{name} whenever ANY class is on the stack, regardless of how deep inside a method the definition sits, so a closure inside Class.test_x is emitted as mod:Class.<closure> -- the METHOD name is dropped, not the class. Two same-named closures in two methods of one class collide and their caller sets union. A class defined inside a function is separately named as if module-level. Write the failing test against those 4 named collisions FIRST. (b) Referenced-by: the name list omits the defining module while the count includes it, and nothing states that the count already excludes definition/import/docstring mentions -- so the map says 3 where grep says 7 and the reader cannot tell which is wrong.
